CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of Prophecies about the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prophecies about the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophecies about the Messiah.
   C. Use Prophecies about the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Prophecies about the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Use of Natural Resources? (1 mark)
   A. Use Use of Natural Resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Use of Natural Resources.
   C. Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Use of Natural Resources has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Accounts of Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Accounts of Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Accounts of Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Accounts of Creation.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Responsibility over Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Use Responsibility over Plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Responsibility over Plants.
   C. Say Responsibility over Plants has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Responsibility over Plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ.

8. Which response best shows understanding of John the Baptist to the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing John the Baptist to the Messiah.
   B. Use John the Baptist to the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of John the Baptist to the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say John the Baptist to the Messiah has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use Divisions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Divisions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Bible.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Leadership in Israel has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel.
   D. Use Leadership in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

12. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.
   C. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Stewardship over Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Responsibility over Plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Use of Natural Resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Functions of the Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. D — Apply the teaching of Prophecies about the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. D — Apply the teaching of Responsibility over Plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

7. C — Apply the teaching of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of John the Baptist to the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. A — Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Stewardship over Creation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Use of Natural Resources; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Functions of the Bible; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
